For anyone interested, I wanted to give a little backstory on just exactly why I’m so proud of myself for having survived. Warning, this might be hard to read. As many of you know, I recently had a baby. What many don’t know, is that my pregnancy lead to my demise.

My mental health was in decline the minute I got pregnant because of the raging hormones. It was really hard for me to enjoy my pregnancy because I was always angry and fighting with my husband. It ultimately lead to us splitting up, and it also lead to my postpartum depression.

I was afraid that my baby was no longer safe with me because of my explosive anger, so I ran away, leaving her to my mother’s care. To this day, I will never forgive myself for leaving the way I did. Anyway, at this point, my husband and I were still together.

I fled to Arizona where he was working, in hopes that my time away from my baby would help calm me down and I would be fine when I came back. But I fell into a drug addiction with opioids and then I got into a physical fight with my husband.

I got hurt. Bad. He gave me a concussion and I was bruised head to toe. We were both arrested and went to jail for one night. But I never told anyone what he did to me. The day we were supposed to get released, ICE took him into custody, and I was DEVASTATED.

I was so mentally screwed up and afraid. I was so codependent on him, and I was scared of having to learn to be a mother on my own while trying to get clean and dealing with my postpartum depression. I just wanted my husband to be with me. So he lured me to take my baby to Cali.

He came for me and my daughter, and we were all in Cali for a few days. We got into a fight again, he threw me in jail, and took my daughter away from me. He kept her for a week before I got my own lawyer in El Paso and won her back. When I got her back, that’s when I was in hell

He came for me and my daughter, and we were all in Cali for a few days. We got into a fight again, he threw me in jail, and took my daughter away from me. He kept her for a week before I got my own lawyer in El Paso and won her back. When I got her back, that’s when I was in hell

I would NEVER get out of bed. I would never eat, would never shower, would never drink water. I had to be forced to do all of those things at least once a day. I lost so much weight. I would cry myself to sleep every single night, not even slightly exaggerating.

I wanted to take my life every day. I had no will to live, it was so hard for me to breathe. I was miserable. I was going through a divorce, I had been through physical abuse, I had to deal with postpartum depression and being a freshly single mother.

And now I have a JOB and I have a NEW PLACE that I’ll be moving into soon. My first time living on my own!!! I ducking made it through suicide attempts, postpartum depression, drug addiction, physical abuse, divorce, and being in debt. ANYTHING is possible you guys. ANYTHING.
